latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Risk Storming Facilitator skill.

- Helps users plan and facilitate collaborative architecture risk identification sessions.
- Guides users to focus on a single risk dimension (e.g., security, availability, etc.) per session for best results.
- Offers prompts and checks for required context: architecture description, risk focus, and team roles.
- Produces facilitation artifacts (agenda, pre-work, guides); actual session is run by the user.
- Recommends team composition and visual materials for effective risk storming.
- Triggers on key phrases about risk workshops, collaborative risk sessions, or user intent to run risk identification activities.
